slides.title: Bad night. Workout planned. Now what?
slides.body: Forcing it or skipping it aren't your only two options.

slides.title: Record it. Don't judge it.
slides.body:
Note three things separately:
• the night: when you woke, for how long
• your fatigue right now
• your willingness to move

slides.title: Ask what today can support
slides.body:
How much usable energy is here now?
Does gentle movement feel OK?
Does the planned session still fit?

slides.title: Pick one of three
slides.body:
1. A modified plan
2. Gentle movement
3. Deliberate rest

slides.title: Set the boundary before you start
slides.body: A starting point you can keep, and one cue that tells you to stop.

slides.title: Rest can be the plan
slides.body: Planned rest isn't failure, and it isn't a debt to repay tomorrow. Tomorrow is a new decision.

slides.title: The full Morning Capacity Check
slides.body:
Short guide + printable decision card + 7-day broken-night practice sheet.
